targetPopulation: Public https sites drawn from the frozen frame: sites across the corpus categories that served two successful unauthenticated automated desktop visits during the preregistered reliability sweep. Rates describe this frame population only, under passive consent-banner observation with no consent action, and are never an all-visitors or all-web estimate.

design.selectionProtocol: Frame of exactly 400 sites drawn by seeded simple random sampling from the reliability-screened candidate pool defined in docs/calibration-prereg-drafts/frame-construction.md: a fixed pool of 600+ candidates composed half from the detector's likely-positive strata defined in frame-construction.md and half from likely-clean strata (reference, government, open source), every candidate having passed two pre-freeze automated visits under the exact measurement condition. The random seed is the SHA-256 of this study's committed preregistration.json, computed after commit and recorded in the frame tooling output, so the draw is deterministic, reproducible, and fixed before any acquisition.
design.referenceProtocol: Each labeler independently reviews the blinded per-case evidence bundle and asserts present when a consent control was VISIBLY OFFERED to the visit: a consent banner or dialog rendered and visible in the page or one of its frames at observation time. Absent otherwise. A CMP loader request, a consent framework endpoint, or CMP markup that never rendered a visible control is NOT present. The implemented calibration seam predicts banner visibility (banner-visibility@1) and nothing else; a label that also counted loader requests would score every region-gated 'CMP loaded, no banner shown' visit as a detector false negative, which under a single US egress is a systematic artifact of where the scanner sits rather than an error the detector made. Any study using this plan measures banner visibility, which is NOT the detector's published finding text ('A consent management platform was requested'); a rate from it must be presented against the proposition it measured.
design.adjudicationProtocol: Two through ten distinct GitHub actors label every case independently and blind to each other. One additional distinct actor precommits a blind tiebreaker source before acquisition. Agreements stand as final. Any disagreement is resolved by the precommitted tiebreaker alone, recorded as disagreement-resolved-by-blind-tiebreaker with the tiebreaker identity and artifact digest; no post-hoc discussion, relabeling, or majority vote occurs.

measurementCondition.interpretation: Rates are conditional on desktop visits with GPC disabled under passive consent-banner observation with no consent action.
